critique.summary: The generated world put Witness B where she said she was ("on the corner near the crossing"), not where she marked on Exhibit 4. In the deposition video she marks a spot about 11.1 m away, behind the Bus shelter with solid ad panel (SE corner). Moving her there blocks her view of the signal, so the world is patched and her claim must be re-tested.

findings.summary: Witness B is placed from her vague spoken description, not from the position she physically marked on Exhibit 4.
findings.detail: At Depo 00:44 she says only "I was waiting for the early bus, over on the corner near the crossing. I had a good view of everything from where I was standing.". At Depo 01:16-01:36 the video shows her marking a red X on Exhibit 4 at approx (x 7, z 16.5) m in the world frame, 11.1 m from where world_v1 places her [5.5, 0, 5.5]. The mark is the controlling evidence of position; the transcript never states it.

critique.summary: With Witness B at her marked position the world matches the evidence. Her claim that she "saw the light clearly" and that nothing was between her and the signal is contradicted: the Bus shelter with solid ad panel (SE corner) blocks her line of sight to the signal head at t=6.5s. No further patch is needed; the contradiction is in the testimony.

findings.summary: Witness B could not have seen Signal for northbound Main St (NE corner) from where she marked she was standing.
findings.detail: Her eye-level render at t=6.5s shows the Bus shelter with solid ad panel (SE corner) filling the direction of the signal head. The ray-cast check agrees (blocked by occ_shelter, 22.8 m to the signal). She testified "The light was red for the northbound truck. I am certain of that. I saw it clearly." (Depo 01:50) and that nothing was between her and the signal (Depo 02:20).

evidence.citation: Depo 02:20 ("nothing that I recall" between her and the signal)
